chapters.story: 追查将香客灾祸转嫁给无名者的转灾账。
chapters.mechanic: 三盏净愿灯近身净化，再完整避过十字焚线，收炉时破防。
chapters.reward: 养魂神木保底2份，另有精英与劫压额外奖励。

chapters.story: 袈裟内缝着替山民还债的卖命契；借熊扑撞醒缄声风钟。
chapters.mechanic: 风钟免疫剑伤，诱扑撞钟，随后避过三段爪风。护钟期间也穿插爪击。

chapters.story: 辨认骨愿中仍然活着的神木脉线，寻找大圣留下的半句真话。
chapters.mechanic: 斩金色脉线真碑，空碑触发有预警的追声反噬。三重骨声按外、内、外完成；失败后追加追声反击。
chapters.reward: 养魂神木保底2份；结尾引向未开放的高老庄。

maps.patrol: 无限巡逻，入坛停止探索增援，保持原有安全生成和预警。

difficulty.note: 同时叠加已有难度、营地阶段与冻结的角色实力快照；不通过增加同时存活上限提高难度。

rewards.note: 可选定向材料，界面展示养魂神木及用途。保底与稀有奖励沿用原领取台账，死亡、刷新不重复发放。

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent isometric environment prop atlas for a realistic dark Chinese cultivation action game. Exact grid FOUR columns by THREE equal rows, landscape 4:3 sheet, ideally 2048x1536, true transparent background, no labels, no borders no floor no baked shadow, each prop entirely isolated with generous clear padding. Elevated orthographic three-quarter camera, hand-painted realistic 3D detail, crisp surfaces, unified scale within each type. Columns left to right: 1 elaborate entrance gate arch with two supports and clear passage beneath; 2 tall environmental tree or natural pillar; 3 standing ritual brazier or hanging wind bell on post; 4 small wayside shrine pavilion. Row1 BURNED MONASTERY: charred red-and-bronze ruined temple gate, scorched sacred tree with a few ember leaves, bronze incense brazier on plinth burning subdued orange, ruined vermilion shrine with prayer tablets. Row2 BLACK WIND FOREST: a giant twisted-root arch gate, enormous mossy dark forest tree with a broad jade-dark canopy and hanging prayer knots, bronze wind bell suspended from ancient wood post, woodland root shrine tangled with vines. Row3 WISH-BONE GROTTO: ivory limestone arch with subtle riblike organic forms, tall stalagmite cluster with thin pale soul roots, amethyst soul lantern on carved ivory pedestal, limestone ossuary shrine with pale sacred tree roots. ALL 12 props fit fully inside their own cells, no crossing boundaries, no symbols or text, no people no animals, realistic textures not cartoon, coherent restrained lighting with clear readable silhouettes.
